verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Cahora Bassa Dam frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.

Urban source relief may contain building/canopy artifacts and does not resolve individual dam foundations, crest/wall or gorge bathymetry. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
